verdict.rationale: Whisper is API- and library-first, with no first-party UI evidenced, so its documented capabilities are all exposed programmatically. These include hosted transcription with file upload, streaming, prompt/keywords/languages controls and JSON output, plus an official CLI. The open-source Python package covers transcription, translation and lower-level decode/detect_language access. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), evidence that hosted-API translation matches the open-source capabilities, and independent corroboration of parity.
